metadata.goldstone:source:
# Every stroke, vertex kind, shape and an axis, for visual checks. format = 1
[[vertex]] id = "l1" at = [0, 0] [[vertex]] id = "r1" at = [80, 0] [[edge]] from = "l1" to = "r1" label = "plain" arrow = "forward"
[[vertex]] id = "l2" at = [0, -20] [[vertex]] id = "r2" at = [80, -20] [[edge]] from = "l2" to = "r2" stroke = "dashed" label = "dashed"
[[vertex]] id = "l3" at = [0, -40] [[vertex]] id = "r3" at = [80, -40] [[edge]] from = "l3" to = "r3" stroke = "dotted" label = "dotted"
[[vertex]] id = "l4" at = [0, -60] [[vertex]] id = "r4" at = [80, -60] [[edge]] from = "l4" to = "r4" stroke = "wavy" label = "wavy"
[[vertex]] id = "l5" at = [0, -85] [[vertex]] id = "r5" at = [80, -85] [[edge]] from = "l5" to = "r5" stroke = "curly" label = "curly"
[[vertex]] id = "l6" at = [0, -110] [[vertex]] id = "r6" at = [80, -110] [[edge]] from = "l6" to = "r6" stroke = "zigzag" label = "zigzag"
[[vertex]] id = "l7" at = [0, -130] [[vertex]] id = "r7" at = [80, -130] [[edge]] from = "l7" to = "r7" double = true arrow = "backward" label = "double"
# Curved geometry [[vertex]] id = "p" at = [120, -60] kind = "dot" [[vertex]] id = "q" at = [180, -60] kind = "dot" [[edge]] from = "p" to = "q" bend = 60 stroke = "wavy" [[edge]] from = "p" to = "q" bend = -60 arrow = "forward" [[edge]] from = "q" to = "q" loop = { radius = 12, angle = 0 } stroke = "curly" [[edge]] from = "p" to = "p" loop = { radius = 10, angle = 180 } arrow = "forward" [[vertex]] id = "s1" at = [120, -120] [[vertex]] id = "s2" at = [180, -120] [[edge]] from = "s1" to = "s2" controls = [[140, -90], [160, -150]] stroke = "dashed" arrow = "forward"
# Vertex kinds [[vertex]] id = "k1" at = [120, 0] kind = "dot" label = "dot" [[vertex]] id = "k2" at = [140, 0] kind = "cross" label = "cross" [[vertex]] id = "k3" at = [160, 0] kind = "ocross" [[vertex]] id = "k4" at = [180, 0] kind = "circle" [[vertex]] id = "k5" at = [200, 0] kind = "square" color = "blue"
[[shape]] kind = "ellipse" at = [230, -60] size = [20, 30] fill = "lightgray" [[shape]] kind = "box" at = [230, -110] size = [20, 12] rotation = 20 color = "red"
[[axes]] origin = [-10, -175] x = { length = 110, label = "$s$", ticks = true, tick_spacing = 20, tick_labels = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5"] } y = { length = 30, label = "$E(s)$" }
